# Fernwood 2.7.0

## What's New

**Offline Mode**
Fernwood now works without a connection. Your content stays available when you're on a plane, in a tunnel, or out of signal range. Any changes you make sync automatically once you're back online, so you never lose your work.

## Improvements

**40% Faster Cold Start**
We've reworked how Fernwood loads at launch. The app now opens about 40 percent faster, getting you to your content in less time, even on older devices.

## Bug Fixes

**Android 15 Login Loop**
We fixed an issue that sent some Android 15 users back to the login screen repeatedly after signing in. Logging in now works as expected.

## Platform Changes

**iOS 16 No Longer Supported**
Fernwood 2.7.0 requires iOS 17 or later. If you're on iOS 16, you can keep using your current version, but it won't receive further updates. We recommend updating your device to get the latest features and security improvements.

---

Thanks for using Fernwood. Questions or feedback? Reach out to our support team anytime.
